tokenListFormats: application/statuslist+jwt, or application/statuslist+cwt by Accept; {bits} bits per credential
about1: Every credential this realm issues carries its index here: a dc+sd-jwt and a jwt_vc_json in the Token Status List (draft-ietf-oauth-status-list), a jwt_vc_json and an ldp_vc in the two Bitstring Status Lists (W3C). One index, the same in every list. A verifier fetches the list and reads the bit; this service's own Verifier reads it directly.
about2: A credential is shown INVALID when it was revoked here, when an administrator revoked it on
about3: , or when a global sign-out disowned it. INVALID is final. SUSPENDED can be reinstated. Either stops the credential signing anybody in at /authn/wallet.
none: No credential issued here carries a status yet.
